name: 27360 · Thomasville, NC
findings: ZIP 27360 (Thomasville) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27360 (Thomasville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27360 (Thomasville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
